abstract: Ineffective teamwork and communication can generate medical errors in the high-pressure environment of surgery, making post-operative debriefings essential for enhancing team performance and patient safety. However, these sessions are frequently rushed or incomplete due to clinicians’ limited time. This paper introduces ReflectOR, an Agentic-AI architecture designed to support surgical debriefings by processing audio recordings from the operating room. The system employs specialized sub-agents that perform tasks such as generating summaries, constructing timelines of intraoperative events, identifying potential errors and counting the materials used. A qualitative evaluation indicates that the system effectively contextualizes transcripts, demonstrating its potential as a valuable tool for surgical debriefing. The paper also outlines key considerations for applying such an architecture in real-world clinical environments.

oneSentenceThesis: 针对术后复盘常被压缩且依赖记忆易漏信息的问题，ReflectOR 采用音频增强转写加协调器调度六个专科子智能体的两段设计，在 5 分钟意大利语模拟手术音频上以零样本取得转写 10.72% 与分离 10.89% 的最低误差，而代价是结论高度依赖音频质量且仅经单中心受控小样本定性验证。
originalTitle: ReflectOR: an LLM-based Agent for Post-Operative Surgical Debriefing
readerTitle: 手术室术后复盘智能体：从噪声对话到结构化总结
